# SENZ Strategic Communications

Influence Through Clarity. An FMB&CO company, founded by Francine Marie Bautista.
Primary market: Philippines. Contact: info.senz.pr@gmail.com.

## Capabilities
- Strategic Communications: positioning, branding, PR, reputation, stakeholder messages, and content strategy.
- Digital Solutions: websites, portals, operations, and scoped integrations.
- AI Systems: suitable AI-assisted writing, knowledge, and communications workflows.

Start with the client's problem. Not every customer needs all three capabilities.

## Product readiness
Eight products are implemented in the private SENZ App source: AI Workspace, Communications Intelligence, Digital Assistant, FotoLab, Client Portal, Event Systems, Digital Representative, and Music Platform. Local source testing is not proof of live readiness. No self-service purchase is currently announced. Four products use AI; FotoLab, Client Portal, Event Systems, and Music Platform are digital workflows, not generative AI products.

## Products and their purpose
<!-- catalog:llms:start -->
- SENZ AI Workspace (In development; Uses AI): Solves: Drafting, summarizing, and organizing work takes too long. Turn your own notes, goals, and source text into usable first drafts, and keep every version. For: Professionals, small businesses, and teams who write every day. Limits: Uses only what you provide. It does not browse the web, send, or publish anything, and every draft needs human review. Included in the Individual, Professional, Business and Institutional License plans.
- SENZ Communications Intelligence (In development; Uses AI): Solves: Important messages go out unplanned, unclear, or without proper approval. Prepare important messages properly: plan them, check them, and approve them before they go out. For: Communications officers, schools, local governments, agencies, and organizations. Limits: It does not publish or send messages, and it does not replace legal advice or a crisis team. Included in the Individual, Professional, Business and Institutional License plans.
- SENZ Digital Assistant (In development; Uses AI): Solves: People keep asking the same questions, and answers are slow or inconsistent. Answer the questions people keep asking on your website, using only answers you approve, and pass anything else to a person. For: Businesses, schools, clinics, venues, and organizations with repeat questions. Limits: It never answers outside your approved knowledge, and it does not take payments or make bookings. Included in the Professional, Business and Institutional License plans.
- SENZ FotoLab (In development; Digital workflow (no AI)): Solves: Photos are scattered, and editing them risks losing the originals. Keep your photos in private projects and make careful edits without ever losing the original. For: Individuals and small teams who prepare their own images. Limits: A self-service editor, not a retouching service by SENZ staff. It does not generate or alter images with AI. Included in the Individual, Professional and Institutional License plans.
- SENZ Client Portal (Custom implementation; Digital workflow (no AI)): Solves: Clients of a SENZ project need one place to follow progress, review deliverables, and approve the work. One private place for a contracted project between SENZ and a client: what is due, what was delivered, and what was approved. For: SENZ clients working under a signed project agreement. Limits: Set up by SENZ for each contract. It is not a general CRM, form builder, or public file-sharing service. Included with SENZ service engagements; not sold on its own.
- SENZ Event Systems (Custom implementation; Digital workflow (no AI)): Solves: Event sign-ups are manual: overbooking, lost registrations, and slow check-in at the door. Run event registration from announcement to the door: take sign-ups within capacity, manage a waitlist, and check people in. For: Schools, organizations, and event organizers. Limits: It does not sell tickets or run voting or tabulation. Set up under a custom implementation agreement after a scoping review.
- SENZ Digital Representative (Custom implementation; Uses AI): Solves: A brand or public figure receives more questions than can be answered personally. Let a brand or person be represented by a clearly disclosed text assistant that speaks only from approved information, and only while consent is in place. For: Public figures, brands, and organizations under a signed agreement. Limits: Text only. It has no voice or video likeness and is never presented as the real person. Set up under a custom implementation agreement after a scoping review.
- SENZ Music Platform (Custom implementation; Digital workflow (no AI)): Solves: Music projects are shared through scattered links, with unclear feedback and unconfirmed rights. Review and deliver music projects privately: listen to protected previews, give timestamped feedback, confirm rights, then release the files. For: Artists, producers, and clients working with SENZ under a music project agreement. Limits: It does not stream music to the public, publish charts, or generate music. Set up under a custom implementation agreement after a scoping review.
